name: freecad-mcp-bridge
description: Connect to a running FreeCAD session through the FreeCAD MCP Bridge addon.
long_description:
Connects to an open FreeCAD session, so Claude can run Python in FreeCAD and read the output.

Needs FreeCAD's MCP Bridge addon. Setup instructions are in the [README on GitHub](https://github.com/CREATeNG/freecad-mcp-bridge#readme).

port.title: FreeCAD MCP Bridge port
port.description: Requires the MCP Bridge addon installed and switched on in FreeCAD. Must match the port of a 127.0.0.1 entry in FreeCAD's Edit → Preferences → MCP Bridge → Listen address. Extension 0.1.26.

token.title: Bearer token
token.description: Leave blank unless Also require on loopback and Require bearer token are on in FreeCAD's Edit → Preferences → MCP Bridge. Then paste the token FreeCAD showed when it was generated.

tls_cert_file.title: TLS certificate file (PEM)
tls_cert_file.description: Leave blank unless Also require on loopback and Require TLS (HTTPS) are on in FreeCAD's Edit → Preferences → MCP Bridge. Then select the PEM certificate file set there. It must cover 127.0.0.1. With a certificate set while the bridge serves plain HTTP on loopback, the connection fails.
